title: MOULA HUSSAIN A
body:
YA SAARALLAH WABNA SAARII
<<DIVIDER>>
1. AAPKA WAARIS HUJJATE AAQER.
HAI JO DALEEL E GHAIB O ZAAHIR.
DEKAY SALAAMI KEHTA HAI SABIR.
<<MINI>>
YAA SAARALLAH.....
<<DIVIDER>>
2. AAPKA MERE DIL MAY HAI MATAM.
KHOON KE AANSOO ROOTI HAI PAIHAM.
CHASHME AZAAYE SHAH HAI PURNAM.....
<<MINI>>
YA SAARALLAH.....
<<DIVIDER>>
3. ADAM O QATAM AAPSE BAAQI.
AAPNE MEHNAT SABKI BACHAALI.
CHASHME AZAA DETEY HAIN SALAMII.....
<<MINI>>
YA SAARALLAH.....
<<DIVIDER>>
4. AAP HAI WAARIS HAQQ LE WALI KE.
AAP PISAR ZEHRA O ALI KE.
AAP HI HAI MEHBOOB NABI KE.....
<<MINI>>
YA SAARALLAH.....
<<DIVIDER>>
5. DIL KE LAHOO KA AAQRI QATRA.
HAQQ KI BAQA KO AAPNE BAQSHA.
NAAM E QUDA HAI AAPSE ZINDA.....
<<MINI>>
YA SAARALLAH.....
<<DIVIDER>>
6. AAPKI MITTI QAAK E SHIFA HAI.
AAPSE HAR MAQBOOL DUA HAI.
AAPKA MASKAN KARBOBALA HAI.....
<<MINI>>
YA SAARALLAH.....
<<DIVIDER>>
7. AAP WASIYE QATM E NUBUWAT.
AAPKE BETON MAY HAI IMAMAT.
KOUN BATAYE AAPKI AZMAT.....
<<MINI>>
YA SAARALLAH.....
<<DIVIDER>>
8. JINN O MALAK BHI ARSH SE AAYE.
AAPKE FHAM MAY ASHK BAHAYE.
AAPJO APNE KHOON MAY NAHAYAE.....
<<MINI>>
YA SAARALLAH.....
<<DIVIDER>>
9. SEENEY KE ZAQMO KO SALAAMI.
SUKHE HUWAY HOTON KO SALAAMI.
KHAAK HUWAY JISMON KO SALAAMI.....
<<MINI>>
YA SAARALLAH.....
<<DIVIDER>>
10. AAPKA AKBAR AAPKA ASGHAR.
HOGAYE QURBAAN DEEN E QUDA PAR.
KAISE BHULAYE KOI WO MANZAR.....
<<MINI>>
YA SAARALLAH.....
<<DIVIDER>>
11. LAASH RAHI BEGHUSL O KAFAN WO.
DHOOP NE BADLA RANGE BADAN JO.
ASHK SALAAMI DETEY HAIN USKO.....
<<MINI>>
YA SAARALLAH.....
<<DIVIDER>>
12. RUQSARON PAR QAAK PADI THI.
ZULM SE SHAIY RAGG SHAIYE KI KATI THI.
REESHE MUBARAK SURQ HUWI THI.....
<<MINI>>
YA SAARALLAH.....
<<DIVIDER>>
13. LAASHA BHI PAAMAL HUWA THA.
AAPKA SAR NAIZE PE CHADHA THA.
ZULM HUWA JO HADD SE SIWA THA.....
<<MINI>>
YA SAARALLAH.....
<<DIVIDER>>
14. GOONJ HAI SADEQ DARD KI HAR SOO.
MARSIYA GOUYII KARTI HAI QUSHBOO.
ROOTEY HAI QAYAM KHOON KE AANSOO.....
<<MINI>>
YA SAARALLAH WABNA SAARII.
<<DIVIDER>>
AZZ:-Ali Anjum Sadiq
